The response should not repeat any word more than 4 times. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a medieval king turning his empire's aesthetic into a proto-vaporwaveassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls adorned with the royal crest. But something is amiss. The once-majestic halls are now filled with the eerie glow of old CRT TVs, their screens flickering with distorted images of 80s VHS tapes.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout man with a thick beard, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the traditional suits of armor, they wear neon-colored jumpsuits and oversized sunglasses.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
We must modernize our aesthetic, my friends. The people demand more... flair.

ADVISOR 1
(nervously)
But, Your Majesty, the people are not ready for such... radical change.

REGINALD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pish posh! We shall be the trendsetters of the land. We shall make our empire the envy of all the neighboring kingdoms.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle grounds are now filled with retro-futuristic contraptions, including old computers, VHS recorders, and cassette players. The sound of distorted synths and eerie ambiance fills the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III stands before a large screen displaying a never-ending loop of VHS tapes. He presses a button, and the screen flickers to life, displaying a montage of 80s music videos, old commercials, and grainy home movies.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
Behold! The essence of our empire's aesthetic. We shall call it... "Reginald's Retro Futurism."

ADVISOR 2
(skeptically)
But, Your Majesty, this is not exactly... regal.

REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, but that is where you are wrong, my friend. This is the future. And we shall be the ones to shape it.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle grounds are now filled with people dressed in neon-colored jumpsuits, dancing to the beat of distorted synths and eerie ambiance. The air is filled with the smell of old electronics and stale air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the traditional suits of armor, they wear neon-colored jumpsuits and oversized sunglasses.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
We have done it, my friends. We have created a new aesthetic for our empire. And it is... (pausing for dramatic effect)...totally tubular.

FADE TO BLACK.
